Application entry point; typically responsible for initializing subsystems including the logging configuration (e.g., reading logging properties and enabling debug output).

UI component that shows exception stack traces to the user; closely tied to logging by presenting logged errors and facilitating debugging.
Developer-oriented panel named *LogPanel*; displays the undo/redo log to help trace state changes during debugging.
Inspector for event pump activity; aids tracing internal events, effectively acting as a live log viewer for developers.

Initialises developer tools including logging and inspector panels; directly supports the logging/trace feature set.
